I replied to Pree in a thread on their correction in #central-team. The reply confirms the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23.

Pree's original Dock 23 post is still in the channel, and so is my earlier reply confirming it. In the reply I suggested Pree edit that post or add a note in its thread, so nobody goes by the old site. I left my earlier reply as it was. Nothing was added to gbrain.
